notes: Graph glyphs are 7-bit ASCII only, like wmo.ts's art: themes swap monoFontFamily, so box-drawing and block elements do not hold a cell width everywhere.
Rain and snow are told apart by glyph, never colour alone (DESIGN.md §8 status-badge rule).

Hourly horizon: 72 h from the current hour (ruled 2026-10-03). Time runs DOWN the graphs, one row per hour, scrolled vertically by finger (confirmed 2026-10-05) — vertical so it never competes with the Page swipe. Unscrolled they show at most 24 h, fewer if the space does not hold 24. The Slideshow never scrolls: a touch ends the presentation.
